title: Outpouring of the Spirit of Grace and Mourning over the Pierced One
description: The Lord will pour out a spirit of grace and supplication on the house of David and the inhabitants of Jerusalem. They will look on him whom they have pierced, and mourn for him as one mourns for an only child. The mourning in Jerusalem will be great, like the lamentation over Hadad-Rimmon in the valley of Megiddo. Each family in the land will mourn separately: the house of David, the house of Nathan, the house of Levi, and the family of Shimei; men and women each by themselves.
